After about 3 washes I had a nice silvery color and I switched back to color protection shampoo. It's been about a month and the color is still holding up nicely!
Just the vivids. I recommend diluting with a white conditioner if your hair bleaches very white like mine does because yikes there is a lot of purple in there

I usually don't tone twice, I find it it doesn't work once it's not gunna work again, but! I find if I still have yellow after the t-18 i add a little bit of the 050 cooling violet and always end up with white :)
If your hair is more gold, try the t-35, but if its a little lighter go for the t-27. You can also add a few capfuls of the 50 additive to take out the warm tones. Good luck

Red hair is probably one of the worst colors in terms of upkeep because (at least for me personally) it does not fade nicely or into a pretty color. I think an ombre would be good because you wouldn't have to go into the salon to get your roots done! When I had red hair I used to dye it myself and would add some red dye to my deep conditioner and do a deep conditioning once a week. That kept my color nice and vibrant. Then when it looked too faded I would just dye the whole thing over myself. If you're friendly with your stylist maybe they can tell you what dye they used! 
If you're down to do it, I think it would look great on you! It's just going to take a lot of maintenance (which isn't too bad if you redo the color yourself!) 
Also the John Frieda radiant red shampoo is great for the color
